messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick thread — proposing a new pricing axis: embeddings priced by dimension bands + quality tiers. idea is simpler bills for customers and clearer unit economics for low-dim cheap embeddings vs high-dim premium. thoughts?
Tom Becker: Can you sketch the bands? e.g., 64/128/768/1536+? Also need to account for models that output variable dims.
Aisha Khan: Yes: Band A = up to 128d, Band B = 129-512d, Band C = 513-1536d, Band D = >1536d. Also a "quality" multiplier for models rated via evals (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Bronze = 1x, Silver = 1.25x, Gold = 1.6x.
Riley Park: Eng: implementation is straightforward for billing (we already log dims). but Console needs UX to show estimated per-request price and a per-model default band. variable-dim outputs require us to bill on actual returned dim for the request.
Oliver Stone (Finance): Financial note: dimension-bands reduce sticker shock for customers using small vectors. multipliers must be conservative. run a sensitivity sim: assume mix 40/35/20/5 for bands and 60/30/8/2 for usage. I'll simulate with current unit cost.
Nina Brooks (Data Strategy): We should tie "quality" tiers to our eval framework: customers can opt into Redwood-evaluated tiers or self-report model performance with a sampling audit. avoids gaming. Also consider discounted rates for embeddings used in re-ranking pipelines (high volume).
Samir Gupta (Legal): Contract implications: define "embedding dimension" as the numeric length of the vector returned. ensure rounding rules (we recommend bill on actual dim, capped to band thresholds). also need language for model-versioning: price band applies per model-version declared at purchase unless customer elects dynamic billing.
Aisha Khan: Launch criteria proposal: 1) pricing cells for bands + quality multipliers, 2) Console UI showing per-call estimate and historical avg dim, 3) billing service change to compute per-call band (backwards compatible), 4) legal template clause for dimension and quality tiers.
Riley Park: Timeline: billing change + backend support = 2 sprints; Console UX + per-model selection = 1 sprint; eval integration for quality tiers = 2 sprints. total MVP ~5 sprints. If we delay eval-backed quality tiers, we can ship bands-only in 3 sprints.
Oliver Stone (Finance): Recommendation: launch bands-only first with optional billing opt-in for dynamic per-request billing. introduce quality multipliers in next phase once eval pipeline integrates. I'll prepare price-cell drafts for bands-only and for full multipliers.
Nina Brooks (Data Strategy): Also propose a grace mechanism: for first 30 days after model onboarding, bill at a promo rate or on the lower band while we observe avg dim; prevents surprises.
Samir Gupta (Legal): I'll draft short contract language: define measurement, rounding, billing windows, audit rights. also flag potential regulatory concerns for embedding exports in certain regions.
quote-bot: I can generate example quote lines once Finance posts base per-dim rates.
Aisha Khan: OK team — next steps: Oliver to post band price-cells by EOD, Riley to confirm engineering estimate and whether bands-only ship in 3 sprints, Samir to draft clause. we'll review tomorrow and decide if this goes on next quarter's roadmap. thanks! :rocket:
